{{Quote|Your family's from Dromund Kaas, aren't they, sir?''"<br />"''The Dromund system is just a myth.''"<br />"''If you say so, sir.|[[Clone commando/Legends|Imperial commando]] [[Darman Skirata|Darman]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Roly Melusar]]|<ref name="501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>}}
The '''Dromund system''', also known as the '''Dromund Kaas system''', was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories's]] [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]] that lay within the region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] known as the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]]. A five-[[Planet/Legends|planet]] system that contained a single [[Star/Legends|star]], [[Dromund]], the Dromund system was historically associated with various [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] organizations. While two of the system's planets, [[Dromund Ixin]] and [[Dromund Tyne]], were barren and a third, [[Dromund Kalakar]], was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]], the two other worlds&mdash;the arid [[Dromund Fels]] and the terrestrial [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]&mdash;could support life, and Dromund Kaas served as the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] for over a thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. However, the Dromund system was largely unknown to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at large throughout most of history.

==Description==
The Dromund system was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]],<ref name="Atlas" /> a region of the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> The system contained one [[Star/Legends|star]],<ref name="Dark" /> a yellow<ref name="Holonet" /> sun named [[Dromund]], and five [[Planet/Legends|planets]]: [[Dromund Ixin]], [[Dromund Kalakar]], [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], [[Dromund Fels]], and [[Dromund Tyne]].<ref name="Dark" /> Located within the [[Stygian Caldera]] nebula, the Dromund system was connected to [[Bosthirda/Legends|Bosthirda]] and [[Jaguada/Legends|Jaguada]] by the [[Kamat Krote]] hyperlane.<ref name="Atlas" /> The [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] maintained a [[Emperor's Fortress|personal space station]] in orbit over Dromund Kaas for much of his reign,<ref name="Guided by the Force" /> though the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]] stole the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] after the Emperor's supposed [[Death/Legends|death]] and moved it to the [[Ilum system/Legends|Ilum system]].<ref name="False">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|The False Emperor}}</ref> The Stygian Caldera nebula was visible from within the star system, painting the fabric of space a reddish-brown [[Color/Legends|color]].<ref name="Descent">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Descent|the Emperor's Fortress}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:Kamat_Krote.png|thumb|left|160px|Dromund Kaas and the Kamat Krote hyperlane]]
{{Quote|There are some interesting historical aspects to this world. Things that perhaps only you and I know, depending on what you've learned from Ship. Such as the fact that this world was a colony of the Sith Empire, but faded into obscurity until after the Great Hyperspace War. It was rediscovered by a Sith armada wandering for two decades.|Luke Skywalker, on the history of Dromund Kaas|<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>}}
The Dromund system was discovered by the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], the civilization of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the planet [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], sometime before the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[6900 BBY]].<ref name="Book of Sith">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] was colonized by the Empire early in its history. However, the colony and the entire system were eventually lost to history along with the Kamat Kroke route by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. The system was rediscovered by researchers on the planet [[Nathema]] under the orders of the Sith Lord Vitiate<ref name="Revan" /> in [[4999 BBY]],<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and he led the remains of the shattered Sith civilization on a [[Sith exodus|exodus]] from Korriban that lasted nearly twenty years before ending in the Dromund system. On Dromund Kaas, Vitiate&mdash;now the [[Immortality/Legends|immortal]] Sith Emperor&mdash;reconstituted the Empire, and the star system became the epicenter of the new civilization.<ref name="Revan" />

In [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|2}}</ref> the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jomar Chul]] scouted the Dromund system in order to determine the defense of the Emperor's space station, and though he was forced to flee the system to escape Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]],<ref name="Guided by the Force" /> his data was used by a [[Jedi strike team (capture of the Sith Emperor)|Jedi strike team]] to infiltrate the system and confront the Emperor aboard his space station.<ref name="Descent" /> In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> during the [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and the Empire, the Dromund system was the site of a [[Dromund Kaas operation|battle]] between the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] and the Empire's [[First Defense Fleet]]. The Republic Navy's attack was a distraction so that the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] could infiltrate Dromund Kaas and eliminate the Emperor, and the Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] withdrew to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] after the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] succeeded in the operation.<ref name="Doomsday">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Doomsday|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>

[[File:Dromund_tor.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A star chart of the system]]
By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[2000 BBY/Legends|2000 BBY]], the Dromund system was once more abandoned, and though Dromund Kaas was the site of a [[Battle of Dromund Kaas (New Sith Wars)|battle]] in [[1004 BBY]] between the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the Sith [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]],<ref name="Atlas" /> the system remained uninhabited until sometime after [[990 BBY]], when the rogue Sith Lord [[Darth Millennial]] fled to Dromund Kaas and established the [[Dark Force]] religion there. The Dark Force's followers, the [[Prophets of the Dark Side]],<ref name="Evil">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref> ruled the few inhabitants of Dromund Kaas and remained unknown to the galaxy at large until [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], when the Sith Lord [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] discovered the Prophets on Dromund Kaas.<ref name="Dark" /> Shortly before that time, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] attempted to start a revolt against the Prophets, though he was killed. As a result, his son [[Roly Melusar]] developed a strong hatred of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]], and he told anyone who asked him that the Dromund system was a myth.<ref name="501st" /> The system and its planets were believed to be mythical by [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at large, but the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] confirmed the system's existence during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="Dark" /> and the Republic's [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps]] fought a [[Battle of Dromund Kaas|battle]] on Dromund Kaas during the conflict.<ref name="Grand">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref>

In the [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] that followed, the system was visited at least twice by members of the [[New Jedi Order]]&mdash;first in
[[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], when the [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] [[Mission to Dromund Kaas (New Republic)|rescued]] her teacher [[Kyle Katarn]] from Dromund Kaas after the Jedi Knight was driven to the dark side by the planet;<ref name="Mysteries">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''</ref> and in [[44 ABY]], when [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], his son [[Ben Skywalker]], [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], and [[Vestara Khai]] were [[Duel on Dromund Kaas|ambushed]] by a group of [[Sith Saber]]s under the leadership of Vestara's father [[Gavar Khai]] on Dromund Kaas.<ref name="Ascension" />

==Orbital bodies==
===Dromund Ixin===
{{Main|Dromund Ixin}}
'''Dromund Ixin''' was a barren world without satellites, the closest to the star Dromund.<ref name="Dark" />

===Dromund Kalakar===
{{Main|Dromund Kalakar}}
'''Dromund Kalakar''' was the second planet in the Dromund system, a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] orbited by six [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="Dark" /> One of these moons, the volcanic [[Kalakar Six]], was a mining colony of the reconstituted Empire, though an eruption buried the settlement in ash.<ref name="Silent City">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|A Silent City}}</ref> Thousands of years later, the Prophets of the Dark Side lured the Sith Lord [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to the moon and its powerful [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Vergence/Legends|nexus]], where they [[Duel on Kalakar Six|pitted]] a doppelgänger of the Sith Lord [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] against Vader.<ref name="Resurrection">{{Tales|9|Resurrection (comic story)}}</ref>

===Dromund Kaas===
[[File:DromundKaas-TOR.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Dromund Kaas]]
{{Main|Dromund Kaas/Legends}}
{{Quote|Welcome to Dromund Kaas, where freedom goes to die, and legends are forced on the galaxy.|[[Vette]]|<ref name="Dortmund Kaas ambient">{{TORcite|type=location|Ambient diaologue from Vette|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>}}
The third planet in the Dromund system, Dromund Kaas had two moons<ref name="Dark" /> and was a world of jungles and swamps<ref name="Revan" /> that hosted significant Sith presences throughout much of galactic history.<ref name="Dark" /> As a result of [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]] performed by the Emperor of the reconstituted Sith Empire, the planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] was warped so that Dromund Kaas was constantly shrouded in storms, and it was the site of a powerful dark side nexus. Originally a colony of the first Sith Empire, Dromund Kaas was rediscovered by the reconstituted Empire and served as its capital for over a thousand years,<ref name="Revan" /> though it was largely abandoned and only featured scattered populations of Sith and dark side users.<ref name="Dark" />

===Dromund Fels===
{{Main|Dromund Fels}}
{{Quote|Igrol resides on Dromund Fels.|[[Darth Nyriss]], one of Igrol's fellow Dark Councilors|<ref name="Revan" />}}
Dromund Fels was an arid planet that occupied the fourth orbit around Dromund, and it was orbited by one moon.<ref name="Dark" /> [[Darth Igrol]], a member of the reconstituted Empire's [[Dark Council]], maintained a residence on Dromund Fels during his lifetime,<ref name="Revan" /> and the archaeologists of the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] conducted numerous excavations on the world throughout the Empire's history.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

===Dromund Tyne===
{{Main|Dromund Tyne}}
The fifth planet in the Dromund system, '''Dromund Tyne''' was a barren planet like Dromund Ixin that possessed no moons.<ref name="Dark" />
